description: Source file implementing nested tensor transformation functions for PyTorch, including matrix constraints checks, linear and matmul operations, in-place addition, softmax with dropout, and conversion between jagged and padded dense tensors.

methods.name: check_nested_tensor_matrix_constraints
methods.description: Checks shape and contiguity constraints for nested tensor matrix operations.

methods.name: nested_linear
methods.description: Performs a linear transformation on a nested tensor input.

methods.name: NestedTensor_matmul
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication on nested tensors.

methods.name: NestedTensor_times_Tensor_plus_Tensor_addmm
methods.description: Performs a combined operation of scaled nested tensor multiplication and addition.

methods.name: NestedTensor_add_NestedTensor_in_place
methods.description: In-place addition of two nested tensors.

methods.name: NestedTensor_softmax_dropout
methods.description: Computes softmax with dropout on nested tensor queries.

methods.name: NestedTensor_softmax_dropout_cuda
methods.description: CUDA version of nested tensor softmax with dropout.

methods.name: NestedTensor_batch_offsets_from_size_tensor
methods.description: Generates batch offsets from size tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_to_mask
methods.description: Converts nested tensor to a boolean mask.

methods.name: _jagged_to_padded_dense_forward_cpu
methods.description: Converts jagged tensor values to padded dense tensor.

methods.name: _padded_dense_to_jagged_forward_cpu
methods.description: Converts padded dense tensor back to jagged tensor values.
